lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਵੈਰੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਦੁਸਟਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)taa naal vair kamaavade dusataa naal mohu piaar ||
lines.translation: They inflict their hatred upon the Saints, and they love the wicked sinners.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: agai pichhai sukh nahee mar ja(n)mahi vaaro vaar ||
lines.translation: They find no peace in either this world or the next; they are born only to die, again and again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਬੁਝਈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: trisanaa kade na bujhaee dubidhaa hoi khuaar ||
lines.translation: Their hunger is never satisfied, and they are ruined by duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੇ ਤਿਨਾ ਨਿੰਦਕਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: muh kaale tinaa ni(n)dakaa tit sachai darabaar ||
lines.translation: The faces of these slanderers are blackened in the Court of the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vihooniaa naa uravaar na paar ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without the Naam, they find no shelter on either this shore, or the one beyond. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo har naam dhiaaide se har har naam rate man maahee ||
lines.translation: Those who meditate on the Lord's Name, are imbued with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in their minds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਇਕਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinaa man chit ik araadhiaa tinaa ikas bin doojaa ko naahee ||
lines.translation: For those who worship the One Lord in their conscious minds, there is no other than the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਪੁਰਖ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਜਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: seee purakh har sevade jin dhur masatak lekh likhaahee ||
lines.translation: They alone serve the Lord, upon whose foreheads such pre-ordained destiny is written.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਝਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke gun nit gaavade har gun gaai gunee samajhaahee ||
lines.translation: They continually sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and singing the Glories of the Glorious Lord, they are uplifted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: vadiaaee vadee guramukhaa gur poorai har naam samaahee ||17||
lines.translation: Great is the greatness of the Gurmukhs, who, through the Perfect Guru, remain absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਗਾਖੜੀ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kee sevaa gaakhaRee sir deejai aap gavaai ||
lines.translation: It is very difficult to serve the True Guru; offer your head, and eradicate self-conceit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਨਾ ਮਰਹਿ ਤਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਵੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad marahi phir naa marahi taa sevaa pavai sabh thaai ||
lines.translation: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad shall never have to die again; his service is totally approved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿਐ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: paaras parasiai paaras hovai sach rahai liv laai ||
lines.translation: Touching the philosopher's stone, one becomes the philosopher's stone, which transforms lead into gold; remain lovingly attached to the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis poorab hovai likhiaa tis satigur milai prabh aai ||
lines.translation: One who has such pre-ordained destiny, comes to meet the True Guru and God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਣਤੈ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਸੋ ਪਵੈ ਥਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ganatai sevak naa milai jis bakhase so pavai thaai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Lord's servant does not meet Him because of his own account; he alone is acceptable, whom the Lord forgives. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲੁ ਕੁਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਮੂਰਖ ਅਪਣੈ ਸੁਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahal kumahal na jaananee moorakh apanai suaai ||
lines.translation: The fools do not know the difference between good and bad; they are deceived by their self-interests.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਹਿ ਤਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਲਹਹਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad cheenahi taa mahal lahahi jotee jot samaai ||
lines.translation: But if they contemplate the Word of the Shabad, they obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and their light merges in the Light.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਸਭਾ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sache kaa bhau man vasai taa sabhaa sojhee paai ||
lines.translation: The Fear of God is always on their minds, and so they come to understand everything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਣੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur apanai ghar varatadaa aape lae milaai ||
lines.translation: The True Guru is pervading the homes within; He Himself blends them with the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਭ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak satigur miliai sabh pooree paee jis no kirapaa kare rajaai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they meet the True Guru, and all their desires are fulfilled, if the Lord grants His Grace and so wills. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਾਗ ਤਿਨਾ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਕਹਤਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)n dhan bhaag tinaa bhagat janaa jo har naamaa har mukh kahatiaa ||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed is the good fortune of those devotees, who, with their mouths, utter the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਾਗ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣਤਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan dhan bhaag tinaa sa(n)t janaa jo har jas sravanee sunatiaa ||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed is the good fortune of those Saints, who, with their ears, listen to the Lord's Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਾਗ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਣੀ ਜਨ ਬਣਤਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan dhan bhaag tinaa saadh janaa har keeratan gaai gunee jan banatiaa ||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed is the good fortune of those holy people, who sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and so become virtuous.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਾਗ ਤਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਜਿਣਤਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan dhan bhaag tinaa guramukhaa jo gurasikh lai man jinatiaa ||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed is the good fortune of those Gurmukhs, who live as Gursikhs, and conquer their minds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਦੂ ਵਡੇ ਭਾਗ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਸਿਖ ਪੜਤਿਆ ॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: sabh doo vade bhaag gurasikhaa ke jo gur charanee sikh paRatiaa ||18||
lines.translation: But the greatest good fortune of all, is that of the Guru's Sikhs, who fall at the Guru's feet. ||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਿੰਦੈ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: braham bi(n)dai tis daa brahamat rahai ek sabad liv laai ||
lines.translation: One who knows God, and who lovingly focuses his attention on the One Word of the Shabad, keeps his spirituality intact.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਵ ਨਿਧੀ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਸਿਧੀ ਪਿਛੈ ਲਗੀਆ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਦਾ ਵਸਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: nav nidhee athaarah sidhee pichhai lageeaa phirahi jo har hiradai sadaa vasaai ||
lines.translation: The nine treasures and the eighteen spiritual powers of the Siddhas follow him, who keeps the Lord enshrined in his heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬੁਝਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur naau na paaeeai bujhahu kar veechaar ||
lines.translation: Without the True Guru, the Name is not found; understand this, and reflect upon it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak poorai bhaag satigur milai sukh paae jug chaar ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, through perfect good destiny, one meets the True Guru, and finds peace, throughout the four ages. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਗਭਰੂ ਕਿਆ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa gabharoo kiaa biradh hai manamukh trisanaa bhukh na jaai ||
lines.translation: Whether he is young or old, the self-willed manmukh cannot escape hunger and thirst.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਏ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sabade ratiaa seetal hoe aap gavaai ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs are imbued with the Word of the Shabad; they are at peace, having lost their self-conceit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dar tripat sa(n)tokhiaa phir bhukh na lagai aai ||
lines.translation: They are satisfied and satiated within; they never feel hungry again.
